subject: Finding the golden hour for tri-regional deep dive
messages:
From: Sam Pritchard <sam@cloudlogic.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@cloudlogic.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 14:10:00 +0100
Subject: Deep-dive request: solutions architects + our infra team

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our platform architects want a 60-90 minute technical deep dive (network, auth, perf; we'll bring some sample traffic). We have three regional stakeholders: my team in London (BST, UTC+1), an engineering lead in Sydney (AEST, UTC+10), and the US West infra lead (PDT, UTC-7).

To save time, here are a few candidate overlap windows our group can realistically attend (local conversions included):
- 08:00–09:30 PDT (US West) = 15:00–16:30 BST (UK) = 00:00–01:30 AEST (+1 day)
- 07:00–08:30 PDT = 14:00–15:30 BST = 23:00–00:30 AEST
- 10:00–11:30 PDT = 17:00–18:30 BST = 02:00–03:30 AEST

We'd prefer the middle option (07:00 PDT / 14:00 BST / 23:00 AEST) if it works for your engineers, but the first one gives more overlap with UK daytime. Can you propose a concrete slot and confirm who from Redwood should join (SE, solutions architect, product owner)?

Also: we can take the session on Tue or Wed next week (Sept 14/15). If the time crosses midnight for APAC, they can join briefly but would appreciate if we record and keep a concise action list.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Pritchard
Head of Platform Integrations, CloudLogic
Attachments: timezone_matrix.csv (CSV)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Pritchard <sam@cloudlogic.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request: solutions architects + our infra team

Sam — thanks for the clarity and the proposed conversions. We can support a 90-minute technical deep dive. Suggested attendees from Redwood: Marissa (SE, demo lead), Karthik (runtime architect), and myself (sales + success handoff).

I ran times against our on-call rota and drafted three concrete slots (all in organizer local times and converted):
1) Tue, Sep 14 | 07:00–08:30 PDT / 14:00–15:30 BST / 23:00–00:30 AEST (preferred for CloudLogic)
2) Wed, Sep 15 | 08:00–09:30 PDT / 15:00–16:30 BST / 00:00–01:30 AEST (better for UK overlap, late for APAC)
3) Tue, Sep 14 | 04:30–06:00 PDT / 11:30–13:00 BST / 20:30–22:00 AEST (APAC-friendly but early US)

Notes about DST and "golden hour": Europe/UK is still on BST in mid‑September and the US is on PDT — conversions above reflect that. If this ends up crossing the EU DST change (late Oct) for any future sessions we'll flag it; not an issue for Sept 14/15.

I'm attaching a minimal .ics with those three tentative invites and a timezone_matrix.csv with explicit conversions and UTC times so calendars are unambiguous. Please pick 1/2/3 and confirm who will be the primary contact for APAC (so we can circle back on recording preferences).

If option 1 works, we'll schedule 90 minutes and block a follow-up 30-minute handoff for APAC morning the next day so their architects can watch the recording if needed.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0138
Attachments: proposed_windows.ics, timezone_matrix.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sam Pritchard <sam@cloudlogic.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 17:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request: solutions architects + our infra team

Looping in quickly — I can do option 1 but it's late for APAC. Two quick asks from the SE side:
- Can CloudLogic confirm network egress IPs we'll be testing against? We need to pre-seed firewall lists if they block outbound traffic.
- We'll want a dedicated Slack channel and a short pre-call (15 min) to walk through the artifact set: sample payloads, expected QPS, and a short list of test users.

If option 1 is final, I can be present for the full 90 and do the live kernel/trace walkthrough. If APAC needs to step out early, we'll prioritize live Q&A for them and list follow-ups.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sam Pritchard <sam@cloudlogic.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 18:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request: solutions architects + our infra team

Thanks — small operational note. If we go with option 1 (07:00 PDT / 14:00 BST / 23:00 AEST), please: 
- Confirm the recording permission for APAC attendees (we'll keep recordings in the account folder for 90 days)
- Share any non-prod endpoints and sample auth tokens ahead of time (we'll sanitise and not store tokens)

Also, Marissa, can you add a short runbook item to the invite: "Failure modes we'll demo" with two bullets (auth timeout, KV cache eviction) so the customer knows the focus.

I'll be on for the session and will bring the runtime traces.

— Karthik
Principal Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Sam Pritchard <sam@cloudlogic.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@cloudlogic.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 00:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request: solutions architects + our infra team

Thanks all — option 1 looks good from our side. Confirming: Tue, Sep 14 | 07:00–08:30 PDT / 14:00–15:30 BST / 23:00–00:30 AEST. Attendees: Sam Pritchard (London), Asha Reddy (APAC contact, Sydney), Michael Lee (US West infra).

We'll accept the recording and appreciate the follow-up 30-min handoff for APAC. I'll ask Michael to send the non-prod endpoints and a short CSV of sample payloads by EOD Friday (Sep 11). Please send the calendar invite and Slack channel details when ready.

Sam
Sam Pritchard
Head of Platform Integrations, CloudLogic
Attachments: confirmed_slot.ics (to follow)
